input.command: sed -i '' 's/full_name: fullName/fullname: fullName/; s/r\.full_name/r.fullname/' src/api/users.js && npm test 2>&1 | grep -E "^# (pass|fail)"; git diff --stat

message:
I fixed the failing users test, and it now passes.

The bug was a column name mismatch. `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`, but the migration `migrations/001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`. I changed both references in `src/api/users.js` to `fullname`.

I didn't touch anything in `migrations/`. The migration is marked as already applied in production, so changing the code was the right side to fix.
